scope: Document organization and conditional deadline references only; no tax liability, filing decision or submission.
name: US federal

deadlines.label: Standard calendar-year individual deadline
deadlines.appliesWhen: Calendar-year federal filing, without a special extension or relief; confirm applicability with a preparer.

documents.income: Collect supplied Forms 1099-INT/1099-DIV and investment statements.
documents.disposals: Collect broker disposal statements and acquisition/correction records.
documents.foreign-accounts: Collect foreign-account statements and ask a preparer which separate federal reporting regimes apply.
documents.wrappers: Collect IRA and other account-type and contribution records.
documents.retirement: Collect supplied pension/distribution statements, including Form 1099-R where issued.

questions: Ask whether US citizenship, residency or other status creates obligations even when living elsewhere.
Ask about separate foreign-account reporting; this module does not decide form requirements.
State/local, treaty and disaster-extension cases need separate review.
